projects.name: MetroBeacon
bullets: Built a campus transit-assistance system delivering real-time OC Transpo bus and train arrivals through a mobile app, LED indicators, and a Raspberry Pi Sense HAT display.
Ingested live GTFS-RT trip updates and vehicle positions in Python and published them to a Firebase Realtime Database for cross-device access.

projects.name: FPGA Ethernet Packet Processing Engine
bullets: Designed an FPGA-based Ethernet packet processor in Verilog on the Zybo Z7-20, implementing FSMs, FIFOs, and packet parsing logic.
Implemented CRC generation and validation to ensure reliable packet transmission and data integrity.
Verified functionality using Vivado simulations and self-checking testbenches while analyzing timing closure and FPGA resource utilization.

projects.name: Real-Time Traffic Light Controller
bullets: Designed a real-time traffic light controller in Embedded C on the MSP432, implementing interrupt-driven pedestrian crossing and timer-based state transitions.
Configured GPIO, timers, NVIC interrupts, and debouncing to ensure reliable real-time operation.
Developed modular firmware drivers and validated functionality using Keil µVision and on-board debugging tools.
